definitions.explanation: A term referring to East Asia and sometimes broader Asia, as opposed to the West ({西洋|せいよう}). Encompasses Japan, China, Korea, and often Southeast Asia.

examples.japanese: {東洋|とうよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{興味|きょうみ}→興味：01316_kyoumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{東洋|とうよう}⟦{医学|いがく}→医学：01301_igaku⟧⟦では→で：00502_de⟧⟦{鍼|はり}→鍼：03566_hari⟧⟦や→や：10080_ya⟧⟦{漢方|かんぽう}→漢方：13397_kanpou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Eastern medicine uses acupuncture and Chinese herbal medicine.

examples.japanese: {東洋|とうよう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{西洋|せいよう}→西洋：01446_seiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: Eastern and Western ways of thinking are different.

examples.japanese: {東洋|とうよう}⟦{思想|しそう}→思想：03173_shisou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関心|かんしん}→関心：00182_kanshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: More people are becoming interested in Eastern thought.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{東洋|とうよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{美術品|びじゅつひん}→美術品：28549_bijutsuhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多く：18752_ooku⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This museum displays many Eastern art pieces.

notes:
USAGE: {東洋|とうよう} is used to refer to East Asia and sometimes broader Asia as a cultural region. It contrasts with ⟦{西洋|せいよう}→西洋：01446_seiyou⟧ (the West/Occident).

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{東洋|とうよう}⟦{人|じん}→人：noentry⟧ (Asian person, Oriental - dated)
・{東洋|とうよう}⟦{史|し}→史：noentry⟧ (history of the East/Asia)
・{東洋|とうよう}⟦{医学|いがく}→医学：01301_igaku⟧ (Eastern medicine)
・{東洋|とうよう}⟦{哲学|てつがく}→哲学：03548_tetsugaku⟧ (Eastern philosophy)
・{東洋|とうよう}⟦{思想|しそう}→思想：03173_shisou⟧ (Eastern thought)

NOTE: While {東洋|とうよう} is still used in Japanese (especially in academic contexts), 'Oriental' is considered outdated or offensive in English. Modern English prefers 'Asian' or 'East Asian'.

CONTRAST:
・{東洋|とうよう} - the East, Orient
・⟦{西洋|せいよう}→西洋：01446_seiyou⟧ - the West, Occident
